after_metrics.expected_effect: future real `run.py` executions can accumulate replay coverage without manual file handling

change_summary: Verified the accepted A+B stack baseline (`EV 0.8299 / 0.1255 / 0.0257`) and re-ran the primary window with `--replay-llm`, confirming only 5 covered trading days out of 122 (4.1% coverage, 3 presented signals, 2 vetoes). Updated `quant/run.py` so the main daily pipeline now mirrors `run_pipeline.py`: when `OPENAI_API_KEY` is available it calls the API, saves `investment_advice_YYYYMMDD.json`, and lets `llm_advisor.save_advice()` write `llm_prompt_resp_YYYYMMDD.json` for backtester replay. With no key present, behavior stays prompt-only.

delta_metrics.note: This is a blocker-repair iteration, not a new alpha rule. The key measured outcome is the blocker proof itself: `LLM soft ranking` is still statistically under-covered at 5/122 trading days, so further strategy-layer LLM experiments would still be underpowered until more dated runs accumulate.

hypothesis: `LLM soft ranking` remains the highest-upside strategic branch, but the experiment is still not credible when the main daily entrypoint (`run.py`) only saves prompts. If `run.py` auto-persists dated advice when `OPENAI_API_KEY` is present, then every real production run can compound replay coverage via `llm_prompt_resp_YYYYMMDD.json`, which directly unblocks future LLM attribution and ranking experiments.
next_retry_requires: Do not reopen A+B micro-tuning by default; current evidence still points to `LLM soft ranking` as the next highest-upside direction
Allow replay coverage to compound beyond the current 5 covered trading days before running the next LLM ranking alpha experiment
When coverage is materially larger, measure ranking value with explicit pass-vs-veto or rank-bucket attribution rather than a single-window headline delta
notes: Targeted pytest validation passed (`pytest quant/test_quant.py -k "save_advice or import_advice or replay_log"`: 8 passed). End-to-end API execution was not exercised in sandbox because no OPENAI_API_KEY was provided.

run_py_llm_persistence.new: save prompt only when OPENAI_API_KEY is absent; otherwise save dated advice and replay log
run_py_llm_persistence.old: always save_prompt_only=True; no dated advice file from main daily pipeline
